analysis.methods: Epidemiological and clinicopathological characteristics, with particular emphasis on the 2018 FIGO stage and p16 immunohistochemical expression, were evaluated. Overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS) were analyzed using Kaplan–Meier survival analysis and Cox proportional hazards regression.
analysis.main_results: Among the 122 patients, p16 expression was significantly associated with histopathological subtype. Age ≥55 years and FIGO stage IV were identified as independent predictors of poorer survival and increased recurrence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that p16 expression was not an independent prognostic marker. Instead, FIGO stage and patient age were the primary predictors of survival and recurrence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that FIGO stage and patient age should be prioritized in assessing prognosis for cervical cancer patients. Further research is needed to better define the prognostic utility of p16 in HPV-associated cervical cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and single-center setting. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a single tertiary referral center and does not include prospective data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the prognostic impact of human papillomavirus (HPV) infection on cervical cancer outcomes in an Egyptian tertiary referral center. It aimed to clarify the role of p16 expression as a prognostic marker in invasive cervical cancer, which remains controversial. A retrospective cohort of 122 patients with histologically confirmed cervical carcinoma was analyzed for clinicopathological features, including p16 immunohistochemical expression and 2018 FIGO stage. The results showed that p16 expression was significantly associated with histopathological subtype, but not an independent predictor of survival or recurrence. Age ≥55 years and FIGO stage IV were identified as independent predictors of poorer outcomes. The authors concluded that FIGO stage and patient age are more critical for prognosis than p16 expression. The study's findings have implications for clinical practice, emphasizing the importance of staging and age in cervical cancer management. However, the study's limitations include its retrospective design and single-center setting, which may affect generalizability. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 宫颈癌 仍是全球主要健康挑战。虽然 p16^INK4a^ (p16) 已被确立为 高危型HPV 相关致癌的诊断替代标志物,但其在侵袭性 宫颈癌 中的预后价值仍有争议。本研究评估了 p16 表达结合 2018 年 FIGO 分期的预后意义。方法 在单一三级转诊中心开展回顾性 队列研究 研究,纳入 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间接受治疗的 122 例组织学确诊的宫颈癌患者。评估流行病学和临床病理特征,特别关注 2018 年 FIGO 分期和 p16 免疫组织化学表达。采用 Kaplan–Meier 生存分析和 Cox 比例风险回归分析总体生存 (OS) 和无病生存 (DFS)。结果 在 122 例患者中,p16 表达与组织学亚型显著相关(p 55 年龄和 FIGO IV 期作为较差生存和复发增加的独立预测因素)。结论 在 宫颈癌 中,p16 表达不是独立的预后标志物。FIGO 分期和患者年龄是生存和复发的主要预测因素。尽管 p16 仍是肿瘤分类的有价值生物标志物,但仍需更大规模的前瞻性研究以进一步明确其预后价值。

papers.title: Case Report: Possible spatially-distinct de novo invasive cervical carcinoma in the setting of isolated persistent HPV16 after ALA-PDT-mediated histological clearance of CIN3
papers.abstract: Background Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 (CIN3) is a high-grade precancer, and 5-aminolaevulinic acid-mediated photodynamic therapy (ALA-PDT) offers a fertility-preserving alternative for young patients. However, complete lesion regression does not eliminate the latent oncogenic risk of persistent HPV16, and real-world evidence of invasive carcinoma arising after long-term loss to follow-up (LTFU) post-PDT remains scarce. This case report aims to share this clinical observation and provide real-world evidence supporting risk-stratified post-treatment surveillance for patients with isolated persistent HPV16 after histological CIN3 remission. Case presentation A 32-year-old parous woman with TZ2 CIN3 at the 9/12 o'clock cervical positions achieved histological remission after two cycles of standardized ALA-PDT, yet retained isolated HPV16 infection. Despite repeated clinical reminders, she discontinued all surveillance for 20 consecutive months. Upon voluntary re-presentation, newly developed invasive squamous cell carcinoma was confirmed at the 6 o'clock position—a cervical quadrant spatially distinct from the original CIN3 lesions. This finding raises the possibility of de novo malignant transformation from persistent HPV16; however, pre-existing occult multifocal disease cannot be excluded in the absence of viral clonality or HPV integration-site molecular evidence. Multimodal staging indicated theoretical eligibility for fertility-sparing radical trachelectomy. Conclusions Isolated persistent HPV16 retains long-term malignant potential despite resolved precancerous lesions, and can drive spatially separate invasive carcinoma. Because this inference is based on a single observational case without supporting molecular data, risk-stratified intensified surveillance should be further validated in larger cohorts. Standardized follow-up adherence interventions are required to prevent irreversible fertility loss and advanced disease secondary to discontinuous monitoring.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study addresses the risk of malignant transformation following the resolution of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 (CIN3) with ALA-PDT, particularly in the context of persistent HPV16 infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report of a 32-year-old parous woman with TZ2 CIN3 who achieved histological remission after two cycles of ALA-PDT but retained isolated HPV16 infection. She discontinued surveillance for 20 consecutive months before presenting with newly developed invasive squamous cell carcinoma in a spatially distinct cervical quadrant.
analysis.methods: The case was evaluated using multimodal staging to assess eligibility for fertility-sparing radical trachelectomy. The patient's medical history, treatment protocol, and follow-up adherence were reviewed, and the presence of HPV16 was confirmed through clinical and histological assessments.
analysis.main_results: Upon re-presentation, invasive squamous cell carcinoma was confirmed at the 6 o'clock cervical position, which was spatially distinct from the original CIN3 lesions. The patient had isolated HPV16 infection and had discontinued surveillance for 20 months.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors suggest that the invasive carcinoma may have arisen de novo from persistent HPV16 infection, although pre-existing occult multifocal disease cannot be ruled out without molecular evidence of viral clonality or integration sites.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the potential long-term malignant risk associated with isolated persistent HPV16 infection, even after the resolution of CIN3, and underscore the need for continued surveillance to prevent advanced disease and fertility loss.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a single observational case without supporting molecular data, which limits the strength of the inference. The evidence is considered moderate due to the lack of broader validation in larger cohorts.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 (CIN3) who achieved histological remission after two cycles of ALA-PDT but retained isolated HPV16 infection. Despite repeated clinical reminders, she discontinued surveillance for 20 months before presenting with invasive squamous cell carcinoma in a spatially distinct cervical quadrant. The authors suggest that the carcinoma may have arisen de novo from persistent HPV16 infection, although pre-existing occult multifocal disease cannot be excluded without molecular evidence. The study highlights the long-term malignant potential of isolated persistent HPV16 infection and the importance of continued surveillance to prevent advanced disease and fertility loss. However, the findings are based on a single case and lack molecular confirmation, limiting their generalizability and evidence strength. The study supports the need for risk-stratified intensified surveillance and adherence interventions for patients with persistent HPV16.

papers.title_zh: 病例报告: 在ALA-PDT清除CIN3后孤立持续HPV16感染可能引发空间上不同的原发性侵袭性宫颈癌
papers.source_body_en: Background Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 (CIN3) is a high-grade precancer, and 5-aminolaevulinic acid-mediated photodynamic therapy (ALA-PDT) offers a fertility-preserving alternative for young patients. However, complete lesion regression does not eliminate the latent oncogenic risk of persistent HPV16, and real-world evidence of invasive carcinoma arising after long-term loss to follow-up (LTFU) post-PDT remains scarce. This case report aims to share this clinical observation and provide real-world evidence supporting risk-stratified post-treatment surveillance for patients with isolated persistent HPV16 after histological CIN3 remission. Case presentation A 32-year-old parous woman with TZ2 CIN3 at the 9/12 o'clock cervical positions achieved histological remission after two cycles of standardized ALA-PDT, yet retained isolated HPV16 infection. Despite repeated clinical reminders, she discontinued all surveillance for 20 consecutive months. Upon voluntary re-presentation, newly developed invasive squamous cell carcinoma was confirmed at the 6 o'clock position—a cervical quadrant spatially distinct from the original CIN3 lesions. This finding raises the possibility of de novo malignant transformation from persistent HPV16; however, pre-existing occult multifocal disease cannot be excluded in the absence of viral clonality or HPV integration-site molecular evidence. Multimodal staging indicated theoretical eligibility for fertility-sparing radical trachelectomy. Conclusions Isolated persistent HPV16 retains long-term malignant potential despite resolved precancerous lesions, and can drive spatially separate invasive carcinoma. Because this inference is based on a single observational case without supporting molecular data, risk-stratified intensified surveillance should be further validated in larger cohorts. Standardized follow-up adherence interventions are required to prevent irreversible fertility loss and advanced disease secondary to discontinuous monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 宫颈上皮内瘤变3级(CIN3)是一种高级别癌前病变,5-氨基乙酰丙酸介导的光动力疗法(ALA-PDT)为年轻患者提供了一种保留生育能力的替代治疗方案。然而,完全病变消退并不能消除持续HPV16感染的潜在致癌风险,且在ALA-PDT治疗后长期失访(LTFU)情况下出现侵袭性癌变的现实证据仍较为有限。本病例报告旨在分享这一临床观察,并提供现实证据支持对孤立持续HPV16感染患者在组织学CIN3缓解后进行风险分层强化监测的策略。病例报告 一位32岁经产妇女,其宫颈9点和12点位置存在TZ2 CIN3,经过两次标准化ALA-PDT治疗后达到组织学缓解,但保留了孤立的HPV16感染。尽管多次临床提醒,她仍连续20个月停止所有监测。在自愿复诊时,发现新发的侵袭性鳞状细胞癌位于6点位置——这一宫颈象限与原发CIN3病变空间上不同。这一发现提示可能由持续HPV16感染引发新的恶性转化;然而,在缺乏病毒克隆性或HPV整合位点的分子证据情况下,不能排除既往隐匿性多灶性病变的可能性。多模式分期显示该患者理论上符合保留生育能力的根治性宫颈切除术的条件。结论 尽管癌前病变已缓解,孤立持续HPV16感染仍具有长期恶性潜能,并可能引发空间上不同的侵袭性癌变。由于该推论基于单一观察性病例且缺乏支持性分子数据,因此对孤立持续HPV16感染患者进行风险分层强化监测的策略仍需在更大规模的队列研究中进一步验证。需要标准化的随访依从性干预措施,以防止因间断监测导致的不可逆生育能力丧失和疾病进展。

papers.title: First Results of Mass Immunization of Girls Against Human Papillomavirus in Tajikistan
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) causes 4.5 % of all new cancer cases worldwide, including cervical cancer. Cervical cancer accounts for the vast majority (83 %) of HPV-associated cancers. To evaluate the first results of the immunization campaign against human papillomavirus in girls aged 10–14 years in the context of increasing incidence of cervical cancer in the Republic of Tajikistan. Materials and Methods. The study analyzed statistical data and reports from the Republican Center for Immunoprophylaxis on the progress of HPV immunization in the republic, as well as on the incidence of cervical cancer, obtained from various specialized medical institutions for the period 2014–2025. Results and Discussion . In 2025, 434 new cases of cervical cancer were registered in the Republic of Tajikistan, with a prevalence rate of 4.1 cases per 100,000 women. Over the past five years (2021 to 2025), this rate has increased by 1.5 times. This annual increase is due to the expansion of visual screening coverage under the state program, as well as a possible increase in actual incidence. Since July 2025, the Republic of Tajikistan has become the 53rd country in the WHO European Region to introduce HPV vaccination into its National Immunization Program. The government officially announced the launch of an HPV vaccination campaign for girls aged 10–14 years on October 1, 2025. The preferred vaccination regimen for Tajikistan is the single-dose quadrivalent Gardasil® vaccine, manufactured by Merck & Co. Thanks to collaboration with GAVI, Tajikistan received 623,000 doses of this vaccine. As of October 31, 2025, the number of girls aged 10–14 vaccinated nationwide reached 95.4 % of the target population, or 522,134 girls. The range of vaccination coverage across all regions of the country ranged from 94.9 % to 96.9 %. During the specified period, 48 cases of adverse reactions after immunization against HPV were registered, which amounted to 0.009 %. The most common symptoms were: weakness/malaise (n = 15; 31.25 %); redness of the skin/face (n = 10; 20.8 %); nausea (n = 8; 16.7 %); fainting (n = 7; 14.6 %); increased body temperature (n = 7; 14.6 %) and collapse (n = 5; 10.4 %). Introduction routine HPV vaccination in the National Immunization Schedule of the Republic of Tajikistan is a prudent and strategically important step. Implementing these measures creates the foundation for achieving national and international goals to eliminate cervical cancer and improve the reproductive and public health of women in the country.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估在塔吉克斯坦针对10-14岁女孩开展的人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种运动的第一项结果,考虑到该国宫颈癌的发病率正在上升。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了共和国免疫预防中心2014年至2025年HPV免疫进展情况以及塔吉克斯坦发病率的统计数据和报告。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用来自多个专门医疗机构的统计数据和报告,评估了塔吉克斯坦的人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种进展以及宫颈癌的发病率。
elements_zh.main_results: 过去五年(2021年至2025年),塔吉克斯坦宫颈癌的发病率增长了1.5倍,2025年新增病例434例。10-14岁女孩的疫苗接种覆盖率达到95.4%,记录不良反应48例,占0.009%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将 发病率 的增加解释为由于视觉筛查覆盖范围的扩大以及可能的实际 发病率 的增加。疫苗接种 的高覆盖率和低不良反应率被认为是积极的结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究的结果为实现国家和国际目标奠定了基础,以消除 宫颈癌 并改善塔吉克斯坦妇女的生殖和公共卫生。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究的观察性质以及缺乏详细的方法学描述,本研究的证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Assessing high-throughput surrogate assays for real-world HPV16- and HPV18-specific vaccine immune monitoring: a comparison of PBNA, cCLIA, and IgG
papers.abstract: Introduction Serological monitoring is needed for the real-world evaluation of immune responses after human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination, but the pseudovirion-based neutralization assay (PBNA) is difficult to apply at scale. Methods This study compared PBNA, competitive chemiluminescent immunoassay (cCLIA), and a virus-like particle-based indirect IgG immunoassay for HPV16- and HPV18-specific antibody assessment. The cross-sectional component included fully vaccinated recipients and unvaccinated controls, while the longitudinal component included adolescent girls receiving a two-dose bivalent HPV vaccine. Correlation, classification performance, systematic bias, and agreement were evaluated. Results All three assays reflected HPV16/HPV18-specific vaccine-induced antibody response trends. cCLIA showed a more stable relationship with PBNA results than the IgG assay, especially in longitudinal monitoring and after the second dose. Although the IgG assay showed lower stability than cCLIA for PBNA-defined functional classification, it consistently captured the overall pattern of vaccine-induced antibody responses at the population level. Persistent numerical differences indicated that the high-throughput assays were not directly interchangeable with neutralization titers. Discussion These findings support a stratified strategy for HPV16- and HPV18-specific immune monitoring using PBNA as a functional laboratory reference, cCLIA for high-throughput surrogate assessment, and IgG testing for population-level trend monitoring.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the utility of high-throughput surrogate assays for real-world HPV16- and HPV18-specific immune monitoring, as serological monitoring is essential for assessing immune responses post-HPV vaccination, but PBNA is challenging to implement at scale.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study included a cross-sectional component with fully vaccinated recipients and unvaccinated controls, as well as a longitudinal component tracking adolescent girls receiving a two-dose bivalent HPV vaccine.
analysis.methods: The study compared PBNA, competitive chemiluminescent immunoassay (cCLIA), and a virus-like particle-based indirect IgG immunoassay for HPV16- and HPV18-specific antibody assessment, evaluating correlation, classification performance, systematic bias, and agreement.
analysis.main_results: All three assays reflected HPV16/HPV18-specific vaccine-induced antibody response trends, with cCLIA showing a more stable relationship with PBNA results than the IgG assay, especially in longitudinal monitoring and after the second dose.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest a stratified approach for HPV16- and HPV18-specific immune monitoring, using PBNA as a functional reference, cCLIA for high-throughput assessment, and IgG testing for population-level trend monitoring.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the practical application of different assays for HPV16- and HPV18-specific immune monitoring, which can inform surveillance and population-level trend analysis in public health.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional and longitudinal components may limit generalizability, and persistent numerical differences suggest that high-throughput assays are not directly interchangeable with neutralization titers, indicating moderate evidence strength.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the use of high-throughput surrogate assays for HPV16- and HPV18-specific immune monitoring. It compares PBNA, cCLIA, and IgG assays in a cross-sectional and longitudinal design, involving vaccinated individuals and unvaccinated controls. The results show that all three assays reflect vaccine-induced antibody trends, with cCLIA demonstrating greater stability in longitudinal monitoring. The authors suggest a stratified approach for immune monitoring, using PBNA as a functional reference, cCLIA for high-throughput assessment, and IgG for population-level trends. The study highlights the limitations of direct interchangeability between assays and their potential roles in different contexts. The evidence is moderate due to the study's design and the observed numerical differences.

papers.title_zh: 评估真实世界 HPV16 和 HPV18 特异性 疫苗 免疫监测的高通量替代检测:PBNA、cCLIA 和 IgG 的比较
papers.source_body_en: Introduction Serological monitoring is needed for the real-world evaluation of immune responses after human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination, but the pseudovirion-based neutralization assay (PBNA) is difficult to apply at scale. Methods This study compared PBNA, competitive chemiluminescent immunoassay (cCLIA), and a virus-like particle-based indirect IgG immunoassay for HPV16- and HPV18-specific antibody assessment. The cross-sectional component included fully vaccinated recipients and unvaccinated controls, while the longitudinal component included adolescent girls receiving a two-dose bivalent HPV vaccine. Correlation, classification performance, systematic bias, and agreement were evaluated. Results All three assays reflected HPV16/HPV18-specific vaccine-induced antibody response trends. cCLIA showed a more stable relationship with PBNA results than the IgG assay, especially in longitudinal monitoring and after the second dose. Although the IgG assay showed lower stability than cCLIA for PBNA-defined functional classification, it consistently captured the overall pattern of vaccine-induced antibody responses at the population level. Persistent numerical differences indicated that the high-throughput assays were not directly interchangeable with neutralization titers. Discussion These findings support a stratified strategy for HPV16- and HPV18-specific immune monitoring using PBNA as a functional laboratory reference, cCLIA for high-throughput surrogate assessment, and IgG testing for population-level trend monitoring.

papers.title: Knowledge, Attitudes, and Acceptance of Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Among Women of Reproductive Age Attending a Tertiary Hospital in Southeast Nigeria
papers.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is a major cause of cervical cancer, particularly in low- and middle-income countries where access to preventive services is limited. Despite the proven effectiveness of HPV vaccination in preventing HPV-related diseases, vaccine uptake remains low in many developing countries. Aims: This study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and acceptance of HPV vaccination among women of reproductive age attending a tertiary hospital in Southeast Nigeria. Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 366 women aged 15 to 49 years attending Abia State University Teaching Hospital, Aba, Nigeria. Participants were selected through a multistage sampling technique. Data were collected using a structured, interviewer-administered questionnaire that assessed sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV and HPV vaccination, attitudes towards vaccination, and vaccine acceptance. Data were analysed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 26.0, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results: Most respondents were 25 to 34 years old (40.17%), married (52.19%), and had tertiary education (50.27%). Awareness of HPV was reported by 76.78% of participants. Overall, 45.63% demonstrated good knowledge, 37.43% had moderate knowledge, and 16.94% had poor knowledge of HPV vaccination. Social media (47.27%) and the internet (34.43%) were the main sources of information. Positive attitudes towards HPV vaccination were reported by 63.39% of respondents, while 59.29% demonstrated high vaccine acceptance. The distributions of knowledge, attitudes, and acceptance were statistically significant (p < 0.001). Conclusion: Women attending the tertiary hospital demonstrated relatively high levels of knowledge, positive attitudes, and substantial acceptance of HPV vaccination. However, important knowledge gaps regarding vaccine safety, dosage schedules, and potential side effects remain. Strengthening health education and expanding healthcare provider and digital health interventions may further improve vaccine uptake in Southeast Nigeria.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在尼日利亚阿巴市阿比亚州大学教学医院就诊的366名15至49岁女性中开展了一项描述性横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 数据通过结构化的、由访谈员实施的问卷收集,评估社会人口学特征、对HPV及其疫苗的认知、对疫苗接种疫苗的态度以及对疫苗疫苗的接受度。数据使用IBM SPSS Statistics版本26.0进行分析,统计学显著性设定为p < 0.05。
elements_zh.main_results: 大多数受访者年龄在25至34岁之间(40.17%),已婚(52.19%),拥有高等教育(50.27%)。76.78%的参与者报告了对HPV的知晓。总体而言,45.63%的受访者对HPV 疫苗接种疫苗有良好的认知,37.43%有中等认知,16.94%认知较差。知识、态度和接受度的分布具有统计学显著性(p < 0.001)。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于东南尼日利亚的一家三级医院,这可能影响研究结果的普遍性。由于横断面研究设计和可能存在自我报告偏差,证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 知识、态度和对疫苗接种疫苗的接受度:东南尼日利亚某三级医院生殖年龄女性的调查
papers.source_body_en: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is a major cause of cervical cancer, particularly in low- and middle-income countries where access to preventive services is limited. Despite the proven effectiveness of HPV vaccination in preventing HPV-related diseases, vaccine uptake remains low in many developing countries. Aims: This study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and acceptance of HPV vaccination among women of reproductive age attending a tertiary hospital in Southeast Nigeria. Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 366 women aged 15 to 49 years attending Abia State University Teaching Hospital, Aba, Nigeria. Participants were selected through a multistage sampling technique. Data were collected using a structured, interviewer-administered questionnaire that assessed sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV and HPV vaccination, attitudes towards vaccination, and vaccine acceptance. Data were analysed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 26.0, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results: Most respondents were 25 to 34 years old (40.17%), married (52.19%), and had tertiary education (50.27%). Awareness of HPV was reported by 76.78% of participants. Overall, 45.63% demonstrated good knowledge, 37.43% had moderate knowledge, and 16.94% had poor knowledge of HPV vaccination. Social media (47.27%) and the internet (34.43%) were the main sources of information. Positive attitudes towards HPV vaccination were reported by 63.39% of respondents, while 59.29% demonstrated high vaccine acceptance. The distributions of knowledge, attitudes, and acceptance were statistically significant (p < 0.001). Conclusion: Women attending the tertiary hospital demonstrated relatively high levels of knowledge, positive attitudes, and substantial acceptance of HPV vaccination. However, important knowledge gaps regarding vaccine safety, dosage schedules, and potential side effects remain. Strengthening health education and expanding healthcare provider and digital health interventions may further improve vaccine uptake in Southeast Nigeria.

papers.title: Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Uptake and Perceived Barriers among Women Attending Abia State University Teaching Hospital, Aba, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination remains one of the most effective strategies for preventing cervical cancer. However, vaccine uptake among women in many low- and middle-income countries remains suboptimal due to social, economic, and health system challenges. Aim: This study assessed HPV vaccination uptake and perceived barriers among women attending Abia State University Teaching Hospital (ABSUTH), Aba, Nigeria. Methods: A hospital-based descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 366 women aged 15 to 49 years attending ABSUTH, Aba. Participants were selected using a structured, interviewer-administered questionnaire developed in accordance with the World Health Organisation behavioural and social drivers’ framework. Data on socio-demographic characteristics, HPV vaccination history, perceived barriers, social influences, accessibility, and strategies for improving vaccine uptake were collected and analysed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 26.0. Descriptive statistics, mean scores, percentages, and the chi-square test were used for data analysis, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results: Only 25.68% of respondents had previously received the HPV vaccine, whereas 74.32% had never been vaccinated. Two vaccine doses were the most frequently reported schedule (44.68%). The most important barriers to vaccination were high cost (74.86%; mean = 3.97), fear of side effects (67.49%; mean = 3.72), limited vaccine availability (63.66%; mean = 3.62), inadequate information (61.20%; mean = 3.54), and insufficient healthcare worker discussion (60.93%; mean = 3.50). Government subsidy (86.61%), free vaccination (84.43%), awareness campaigns (83.33%), and improved vaccine availability (82.79%) were the strongest facilitators of vaccine uptake. Significant associations were observed between vaccination uptake and healthcare worker discussion (χ2 = 3.945, p = 0.047), healthcare worker recommendation (χ2 = 21.158, p < 0.001), and peer influence (χ2 = 47.607, p < 0.001). Conclusion: HPV vaccination uptake among women attending ABSUTH was low. Financial constraints, limited access, inadequate information, and poor provider communication were major barriers. Expanding public awareness, subsidising vaccination, and strengthening healthcare worker engagement may substantially improve HPV vaccine uptake.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 仍然是预防 宫颈癌 的最有效策略之一。然而,由于社会、经济和卫生系统的挑战,许多低收入和中等收入国家的女性对 疫苗 的吸收仍然不够理想。目的:本研究评估了在尼日利亚阿巴阿比亚州立大学教学医院 (ABSUTH) 就诊的女性中 HPV 疫苗接种 的摄取情况和感知到的障碍。方法:对 366 名就读阿坝 ABSUTH 的 15 至 49 岁女性进行了一项以医院为基础的描述性横断面研究。参与者是使用根据世界卫生组织行为和社会驱动因素框架开发的结构化、访谈员管理的调查问卷来选择的。使用 IBM SPSS Statistics 26.0 版收集和分析有关社会人口特征、HPV 疫苗接种 历史、感知障碍、社会影响、可及性以及提高 疫苗 吸收策略的数据。使用描述性统计、平均分、百分比和卡方检验进行数据分析,统计显着性设定为p < 0.05。结果:只有 25.68% 的受访者曾接种过 HPV 疫苗,而 74.32% 的受访者从未接种过疫苗。两种 疫苗 剂量是最常报告的方案 (44.68%)。疫苗接种 最重要的障碍是高成本(74.86%;平均值 = 3.97)、担心副作用(67.49%;平均值 = 3.72)、疫苗 可用性有限(63.66%;平均值 = 3.62)、信息不足(61.20%;平均值 = 3.54)以及医护人员讨论不足(60.93%;平均值 = 3.62) 3.50)。政府补贴(86.61%)、免费疫苗接种(84.43%)、宣传活动(83.33%)和提高疫苗可用性(82.79%)是疫苗吸收的最强促进因素。疫苗接种 的吸收与医护人员讨论(χ2 = 3.945,p = 0.047)、医护人员推荐(χ2 = 21.158,p < 0.001)和同伴影响(χ2 = 47.607,p < 0.001)之间观察到显着相关性。结论:参加 ABSUTH 的女性中 HPV 疫苗接种 的摄取率较低。财务限制、准入有限、信息不足以及提供者沟通不畅是主要障碍。扩大公众意识、补贴 疫苗接种 以及加强医护人员的参与可能会大大提高 HPV 疫苗 的吸收率。

papers.title: Geographic and temporal variations in cancer incidence attributable to human papillomavirus infection in China: a population-based study
papers.abstract: Current epidemiological data on cancer incidence attributable to human papillomavirus (HPV) infection in China remain unclear. This study provides an updated assessment of the magnitude of and geographic variability in the incidence of HPV-attributable cancer in China in 2013–2017, temporal trends from 1988 to 2017 and projections to 2032. Data were extracted from the Cancer Incidence in Five Continents Volumes VII – XII . The population-attributable fraction was calculated by multiplying the high-risk HPV prevalence at each anatomical site by the specific biomarker positivity rate in HPV-positive cases. Joinpoint regression and age-period-cohort models were used to quantify temporal age-standardized incidence rate (ASR) trends and age and birth cohort effects, respectively. Bayesian age-period-cohort models were constructed to project the HPV-attributable cancer incidence through 2032. An estimated 68,955 and 3463 HPV-attributable cancer cases were observed among females and males in China in 2013–2017, respectively, with ASRs of 11.20 (95% confidence interval [ CI ]: 10.98–11.41) and 0.52 (0.20–0.82) per 100,000. The most common HPV-attributable cancers were cervical cancer (females; ASR [95% CI ]: 10.92 [10.83–11.00] per 100,000) and laryngeal cancer (males; 0.21 [0.03–0.37] per 100,000). Among the 25 provinces included, the ASRs of HPV-attributable cervical cancer ranged from 6.15 (5.88–6.42) per 100,000 in Beijing to 17.43 (15.84–19.03) per 100,000 in Hunan (2.8-fold difference). The provincial Human Development Index was inversely associated with the cervical cancer incidence in multivariable linear ecological regression analyses. From 1988 to 2017, the ASRs increased for HPV-attributable cervical cancer (females; average annual percent change [AAPC] and 95% CI : 5.89% [2.82–9.06]) and penile and oropharyngeal cancers (males; 1.98% [0.82–3.15] and 9.65% [5.81–13.62], respectively). Substantial increasing risks across successive generations born between 1908 and 1978 were observed for HPV-attributable cervical cancer among females and oropharyngeal cancer in both sexes. Under a counterfactual continuation of historical trends through 2017, without incorporating subsequent vaccination or screening expansion, the ASR of HPV-attributable cervical cancer is projected to reach 19.53 (95% uncertainty interval [ UI ]: 9.99–34.36) per 100,000 in 2028–2032, compared with 10.92 (95% CI : 10.83–11.00) per 100,000 in 2013–2017. In China, the incidence of HPV-attributable cancer varies considerably according to cancer type and geography. These findings highlight the need for region-specific HPV vaccination and cancer screening strategies, particularly in areas with high incidence rates.

papers.abstract_zh: 目前中国发病率(HPV)感染引起的癌症发病率的流行病学数据仍不清楚。本研究对 2013 年至 2017 年中国 HPV 相关癌症 发病率 的程度和地理变异性、1988 年至 2017 年的时间趋势以及对 2032 年的预测进行了最新评估。数据提取自五大洲癌症 发病率 第 VII – XII 卷。通过将每个解剖部位的 高危型HPV 患病率 乘以 HPV 阳性病例中的特定生物标志物阳性率来计算人群归因分数。连接点回归和年龄周期 队列研究 模型分别用于量化时间年龄标准化 发病率 率 (ASR) 趋势以及年龄和出生 队列研究 效应。构建贝叶斯年龄周期 队列研究 模型来预测到 2032 年的 HPV 归因癌症 发病率。2013 年至 2017 年,估计中国女性和男性中分别观察到 68,955 例和 3463 例 HPV 归因癌症病例,ASR 为 11.20(95% 置信区间 [CI]:每 100,000 人为 10.98–11.41) 和 0.52 (0.20–0.82)。最常见的 HPV 相关癌症是 宫颈癌(女性;ASR [95% CI]:每 100,000 人中 10.92 [10.83–11.00])和喉癌(男性;每 100,000 人中 0.21 [0.03–0.37])。在纳入的 25 个省份中,HPV 归因的 宫颈癌 的 ASR 范围为北京每 10 万人 6.15(5.88-6.42)到湖南每 10 万人 17.43(15.84-19.03)(相差 2.8 倍)。多变量线性生态回归分析中,省人类发展指数与宫颈癌 发病率 呈负相关。从 1988 年到 2017 年,HPV 归因的 宫颈癌(女性;平均年百分比变化 [AAPC] 和 95% CI:5.89% [2.82–9.06])以及阴茎癌和口咽癌(男性;1.98% [0.82–3.15] 和 9.65%)的 ASR 有所增加分别为[5.81–13.62])。在 1908 年至 1978 年间出生的连续几代人中,观察到女性中 HPV 相关的 宫颈癌 和男女口咽癌的风险显着增加。根据 2017 年历史趋势的反事实延续,在不纳入后续 疫苗接种 或筛查扩展的情况下,HPV 归因的 宫颈癌 的 ASR 预计将在 2028 年至 2032 年达到每 10 万人 19.53(95% 不确定性区间 [ UI ]:9.99-34.36),而这一数字为 10.92 (95% CI:10.83–11.00) 2013–2017 年每 100,000 人。在中国,HPV 相关癌症的 发病率 根据癌症类型和地理位置的不同而有很大差异。这些发现凸显了对区域特异性 HPV 发病率 和癌症筛查策略的需求,特别是在 发病率 发病率高的地区。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前,中国与高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染相关的癌症发病率数据仍不清楚。本研究旨在通过分析HPV相关癌症的地理和时间变化来填补这一空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在中国2013年至2017年间进行,分析了1988年至2017年的趋势,并预测到2032年。数据来自25个省份,重点关注女性和男性中的HPV相关癌症。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用Joinpoint回归和年龄-时期-出生队列模型来量化时间标准化发病率趋势以及年龄和出生队列效应。通过将每个解剖部位的发病率乘以HPV阳性病例中特定生物标志物的阳性率,计算了人群归因分数。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突出了在1908年至1978年间出生的连续几代人群中,女性HPV相关宫颈癌和男女双方的口咽癌均显示出显著上升的风险。这些发现为理解中国HPV相关癌症的长期趋势和地理差异提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在高发病率地区制定特定区域的HPV疫苗接种和癌症筛查策略的重要性,以应对中国HPV相关癌症日益增长的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于《癌症在五大洲的发病率》第七至第十二卷的数据,这些数据可能存在质量或完整性方面的局限性。由于预测假设历史趋势持续,未考虑未来疫苗接种或筛查干预,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Post-campaign evaluation of the 2025 national human papillomavirus multi-age cohort vaccination campaign in Sierra Leone: a cross-sectional study of coverage, awareness and caregiver attitudes in selected districts
papers.abstract: The introduction of the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine for girls aged 10 years in Sierra Leone facilitated the rollout of the national Multi-Age Cohort (MAC) campaign in 2025. This study assessed HPV campaign awareness, vaccination coverage, knowledge, attitudes, barriers to vaccination, and factors associated with vaccine uptake among primary caregivers during the MAC campaign. We conducted a community-based cross-sectional study after the 2025 HPV MAC vaccination campaign in 10 purposively selected districts across all 5 administrative regions of Sierra Leone. This study included 2,253 caregivers of girls aged 11–18 years. We verified vaccination status during the interview against vaccination cards. We purposively sampled districts and collected data using a structured questionnaire administered via mobile data collection tools. We assessed knowledge only among caregivers of vaccinated girls ( n = 2,097). We used modified Poisson regression with cluster-robust standard errors as the primary analysis model to identify independent factors associated with vaccination status. Vaccination coverage was 94.8% (2,097/2,213, 95% CI: 93.2–96.1) in the evaluated districts. Composite knowledge among caregivers of vaccinated girls was 61% (1,280/2,097), 57.3% recognised cervical cancer prevention, and 46.0% knew the HPV vaccine is a single dose. Overall, attitudes toward the HPV vaccination and MAC campaign rollout were positive (mean attitude score 4.0/5.0). The post-campaign attitude score (adjusted PR: 1.060; 95% CI: 1.033–1.088, p < 0.001), campaign awareness (adjusted PR: 1.057; 95% CI: 1.013–1.102, p = 0.011), and girl attending school (adjusted PR: 1.193; 95% CI: 1.080–1.318, p < 0.001) were independently associated with vaccination status. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the 2025 national HPV multi-age cohort vaccination campaign in Sierra Leone, focusing on coverage, awareness, and caregiver attitudes. A cross-sectional survey of 2,253 caregivers in 10 districts revealed high vaccination coverage (94.8%) and positive attitudes toward the campaign. Knowledge among caregivers was moderate, with 61% having composite knowledge, 57.3% recognising cervical cancer prevention, and 46.0% knowing the HPV vaccine is a single dose. Limitations include the cross-sectional design and potential self-reporting bias, though the evidence is strong due to the large sample size and robust statistical methods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估2025年塞拉利昂全国HPV多年龄队列研究 疫苗接种活动的有效性和接受度,重点关注覆盖率、知晓率以及主要照顾者对该项目的态度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在 2025 年 HPV MAC 疫苗接种 运动之后,在塞拉利昂所有 5 个行政区的 10 个特意选择的地区开展了一项基于社区的横断面研究,涉及 2,253 名 11-18 岁女孩的照顾者。
elements_zh.methods: 采用有目的抽样来选择地区,并使用通过移动数据收集工具管理的结构化调查问卷来收集数据。采用具有集群稳健标准误的修正泊松回归来识别与 疫苗接种 状态相关的独立因素。
elements_zh.main_results: Vaccination coverage was 94.8% (2,097/2,213, 95% CI: 93.2–96.1). Composite knowledge among caregivers of vaccinated girls was 61% (1,280/2,097), with 57.3% recognising cervical cancer prevention and 46.0% knowing the HPV vaccine is a single dose.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,活动后态度得分、活动意识和上学率与 疫苗接种 状态独立相关,凸显了社区参与和教育在 疫苗 吸收中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提供了规划性学习证据,以支持塞拉利昂和其他类似地区的 HPV 从基于运动的免疫策略过渡到常规免疫策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计是横断面的,限制了因果推断,并且分析基于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入偏差。然而,由于样本量大和聚类稳健校正,证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Epidemiological characteristics, genotype distribution, and viral load profiles of human papillomavirus infection among women in the Taihu region of Suzhou: a retrospective study
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity; however, large-scale data regarding genotype distribution and viral load characteristics in the Taihu region of Suzhou, China remain limited. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence, genotype spectrum, age-specific infection patterns, and viral load characteristics of HPV infection among women in this region from 2023 to 2025, thereby providing evidence for region-specific prevention and control strategies. A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted among 23,196 women who underwent HPV testing in the Taihu region of Suzhou between January 2023 and December 2025. Cervical exfoliated cell samples were collected, and 21 HPV genotypes were detected using real-time fluorescence quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). Among the 23,196 participants, 3,061 tested positive for HPV, yielding an overall infection rate of 13.20%, with no statistically significant difference across the three study years. The age-specific prevalence demonstrated a bimodal distribution, with the highest infection rate observed in women aged ≥ 60 years and the lowest in those aged 40–49 years. The five most prevalent HR-HPV genotypes were HPV52 (2.70%), HPV58 (1.72%), HPV16 (1.35%), HPV39 (1.11%), and HPV56 (0.96%), while HPV53 (1.78%) was the most common low-risk genotype. Women aged ≥ 60 years exhibited significantly higher proportions of high-risk mixed infections and multiple infections compared with other age groups. Viral load distribution varied across age groups, with high viral loads being most common in women aged < 30 years (24.29%) and low viral loads predominating in women aged ≥ 60 years (46.82%). The genotype spectrum identified in this study showed greater concordance with the genotypes targeted by the nonavalent vaccine than with those targeted by the bivalent or quadrivalent vaccines. HPV52, HPV58, and HPV16 were the predominant genotypes detected among women in the Taihu region of Suzhou. Older women had a higher prevalence of HPV positivity, mixed HR-/LR-HPV infection, and multiple-genotype infection, whereas the proportion of low viral load measurements increased with age. The predominant genotype spectrum showed substantial theoretical overlap with the genotypes targeted by the nonavalent vaccine.

source_records.title: Epidemiological characteristics, genotype distribution, and viral load profiles of human papillomavirus infection among women in the Taihu region of Suzhou: a retrospective study
source_records.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity; however, large-scale data regarding genotype distribution and viral load characteristics in the Taihu region of Suzhou, China remain limited. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence, genotype spectrum, age-specific infection patterns, and viral load characteristics of HPV infection among women in this region from 2023 to 2025, thereby providing evidence for region-specific prevention and control strategies. A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted among 23,196 women who underwent HPV testing in the Taihu region of Suzhou between January 2023 and December 2025. Cervical exfoliated cell samples were collected, and 21 HPV genotypes were detected using real-time fluorescence quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). Among the 23,196 participants, 3,061 tested positive for HPV, yielding an overall infection rate of 13.20%, with no statistically significant difference across the three study years. The age-specific prevalence demonstrated a bimodal distribution, with the highest infection rate observed in women aged ≥ 60 years and the lowest in those aged 40–49 years. The five most prevalent HR-HPV genotypes were HPV52 (2.70%), HPV58 (1.72%), HPV16 (1.35%), HPV39 (1.11%), and HPV56 (0.96%), while HPV53 (1.78%) was the most common low-risk genotype. Women aged ≥ 60 years exhibited significantly higher proportions of high-risk mixed infections and multiple infections compared with other age groups. Viral load distribution varied across age groups, with high viral loads being most common in women aged < 30 years (24.29%) and low viral loads predominating in women aged ≥ 60 years (46.82%). The genotype spectrum identified in this study showed greater concordance with the genotypes targeted by the nonavalent vaccine than with those targeted by the bivalent or quadrivalent vaccines. HPV52, HPV58, and HPV16 were the predominant genotypes detected among women in the Taihu region of Suzhou. Older women had a higher prevalence of HPV positivity, mixed HR-/LR-HPV infection, and multiple-genotype infection, whereas the proportion of low viral load measurements increased with age. The predominant genotype spectrum showed substantial theoretical overlap with the genotypes targeted by the nonavalent vaccine.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the epidemiological characteristics, genotype distribution, and viral load profiles of human papillomavirus (HPV) infection among women in the Taihu region of Suzhou, China, from 2023 to 2025. A retrospective cross-sectional design was used, analyzing 23,196 cervical exfoliated cell samples. The results revealed a bimodal age-specific prevalence pattern, with the highest infection rates in women aged ≥ 60 years and the lowest in those aged 40–49 years. High-risk mixed infections and multiple infections were more common in older women, while viral load varied significantly across age groups. The genotype spectrum showed greater alignment with the nonavalent vaccine's targets than with bivalent or quadrivalent vaccines. These findings highlight the importance of region-specific strategies for HPV prevention and control, particularly in tailoring vaccine programs to the prevalent genotypes in the population. The study's large sample size and detailed genotype analysis provide robust evidence, though its retrospective nature may introduce some limitations.

papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染表现出显著的地域异质性;然而,关于中国苏州太湖地区HPV基因型分布和病毒载量特征的大规模数据仍较为有限。本研究旨在探讨该地区2023年至2025年间女性HPV感染的病毒载量、基因型谱、年龄特异性感染模式及病毒载量特征,从而为制定区域特定的预防和控制策略提供依据。本研究为一项回顾性横断面研究,纳入了2023年1月至2025年12月期间在苏州太湖地区接受HPV检测的23,196名女性。收集宫颈脱落细胞样本,并采用实时荧光定量聚合酶链反应(qPCR)检测了21种HPV基因型。在23,196名参与者中,有3,061名检测出HPV感染,总体感染率为13.20%,且三年间的感染率无显著统计学差异。年龄特异性病毒载量呈现双峰分布,≥60岁女性的感染率最高,而40–49岁女性的感染率最低。最常见的五种高危型HPV基因型为HPV52(2.70%)、HPV58(1.72%)、HPV16(1.35%)、HPV39(1.11%)和HPV56(0.96%),而低危型HPV中,HPV53(1.78%)最为常见。≥60岁女性的高危混合感染和多基因型感染比例显著高于其他年龄段。病毒载量在不同年龄段中分布不同,<30岁女性中高病毒载量最为常见(24.29%),而≥60岁女性中低病毒载量占主导(46.82%)。本研究中鉴定的基因型谱与九价疫苗所针对的基因型具有更高的理论一致性,而非二价或四价疫苗。在苏州太湖地区的女性中,检测到的主要基因型为HPV52、HPV58和HPV16。年龄较大的女性HPV阳性率、高危/低危型HPV混合感染率以及多基因型感染率更高,而低病毒载量的比例则随年龄增长而增加。主要基因型谱与九价疫苗所针对的基因型存在显著的理论重叠。

papers.title: New form of HPV18 L1 found in native virions contributes to virion stability and infectivity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Current dogma states that papillomavirus virions consist of only one form of the L1 major capsid protein. Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) have been studied using recombinant particles, thereby bypassing the need to grow the virus in a model of differentiating epithelium. Expression vectors engineered to produce L1 utilize a consensus methionine found in many HPV types. However, HPV18 has two additional in-frame methionine residues located 61 and 26 amino acids upstream of the consensus methionine. These methionine residues are excluded from the L1 expression vector used to create the recombinant virus. On the other hand, HPV produced from organotypic raft culture allows virions to be assembled in a differentiating epithelium in the presence of its native promoters and complete genome. Here, we have utilized this system to show that the wild-type HPV18, produced in a more natural setting, translates a larger form of L1 from the upstream methionine, which is 61 amino acid residues upstream from the consensus methionine, and a smaller form from the consensus methionine, with both sizes assembled in the newly formed virion. Ablation of the upstream methionine residue at position 61 altered the virion capsid conformation, and also decreased virion stability and infectivity. IMPORTANCE The present study investigates whether the papillomavirus virions contain more than one isoform of the L1 major capsid protein. By using organotypic raft cultures that mimic the naturally differentiating epithelium, we revealed that wild-type HPV18 expresses and incorporates two distinct L1 isoforms into the virion, including a previously unrecognized longer form translated from an upstream methionine. Our study has further shown that disruption of the upstream methionine impairs virion stability and infectivity, demonstrating that the longer L1 isoform contributes to proper capsid architecture and viral function. These findings offer a new understanding of HPV capsid biology and have significant implications for the future development of HPV vaccines, diagnostics, and antiviral therapies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 当前的教条指出,乳头瘤病毒病毒体仅由 L1 主要衣壳蛋白的一种形式组成。人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 已使用重组颗粒进行了研究,从而绕过了在分化上皮模型中培养病毒的需要。表达 媒介 被设计用于利用许多 HPV 类型中发现的共有蛋氨酸产生 L1。然而,HPV18 有两个额外的框内蛋氨酸残基,位于共有蛋氨酸上游 61 和 26 个氨基酸处。这些甲硫氨酸残基被排除在用于创建重组病毒的 L1 表达 媒介 之外。另一方面,由器官筏培养产生的 HPV 允许病毒粒子在其天然启动子和完整 基因组 存在的情况下在分化的上皮细胞中组装。在这里,我们利用这个系统来证明,在更自然的环境中产生的野生型 HPV18,可以从上游甲硫氨酸(共有甲硫氨酸上游的 61 个氨基酸残基)翻译出较大形式的 L1,以及从共有甲硫氨酸中翻译出较小的形式,两种尺寸都在新形成的病毒体中组装。61位上游甲硫氨酸残基的消融改变了病毒粒子衣壳构象,并且还降低了病毒粒子稳定性和感染性。重要性 本研究调查乳头瘤病毒病毒颗粒是否含有不止一种 L1 主要衣壳蛋白亚型。通过使用模仿自然分化上皮的器官型筏培养物,我们发现野生型 HPV18 表达两种不同的 L1 亚型并将其整合到病毒粒子中,包括从上游甲硫氨酸翻译而来的以前未被识别的较长形式。我们的研究进一步表明,上游蛋氨酸的破坏会损害病毒粒子的稳定性和感染性,证明较长的 L1 亚型有助于适当的衣壳结构和病毒功能。这些发现提供了对 HPV 衣壳生物学的新认识,并对 HPV 疫苗、诊断和 抗病毒药物 疗法的未来发展具有重要意义。

papers.title: Knowledge, Attitude and Practice regarding Human Papillomavirus Infection and HPV Vaccination among Undergraduate Medical Students at a Tertiary Care Teaching Institution in South India: A Cross-sectional Study
papers.abstract: Background: Cervical cancer is an HPV (human papillomavirus) associated disease with India contributing to a disproportionate share of the worldwide burden. Undergraduate female medical students are an at-risk group and future supporters of vaccination yet the gap between knowledge and personal vaccine uptake remains inadequately characterized, especially since India added HPV vaccine to its national immunization campaign. Methods: A questionnaire based cross-sectional study was conducted among all MBBS undergraduates studying in a tertiary care teaching institution in Tamil Nadu using a pre-tested self-administered instrument consisting of sociodemographic items, 15 items of knowledge scale, six items of Likert attitude scale and practice/barrier items. Vaccine coverage was analyzed in female students, the main target population for prevention of cervical cancer. Results: Among the 285 participants, 53.3% were female, and the mean age was 20.3 ± 1.6 years. Good knowledge was present in 172 (60.4%; mean score 10.59 ± 3.78) and a positive attitude in 175 of 277 (63.2%; Cronbach’s α = 0.875). The poorest-answered items concerned the dosing schedule (34.4% correct) and the national-programme status of the vaccine (57.2%). Among female students, self-reported HPV vaccination uptake was 11.8% (18/152), yet 76 of 134 unvaccinated female students (56.7%) were willing to be vaccinated and 80 (59.7%) would accept vaccination after an educational session; the most frequently reported barrier was intention to be vaccinated later (33.3%), followed by lack of information (21.8%). Good knowledge was independently associated with prior awareness of the vaccine (aOR 2.66, 95% CI 1.40–5.04); a positive attitude was less likely in male students (aOR 0.56, 95% CI 0.33–0.94) and more likely with prior vaccine awareness (aOR 1.98, 95% CI 1.04–3.75). papers.title: Post-Treatment High-Risk HPV Testing as a “Test of Cure”: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Excisional treatment is effective for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or 3 (CIN2–3), but residual or recurrent high-grade disease remains clinically important. This focused systematic review evaluated post-treatment high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) testing as a test of cure and compared it with cytology and resection-margin status. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE was searched and supplemented by structured citation checking and targeted verification, with supplementary Embase and CENTRAL searches conducted during peer review; the review was not prospectively registered. Mixed-grade cohorts were retained only when a high-grade subgroup was extractable or for supportive qualitative evidence. Results: Fifteen primary studies enrolled 21,932 treated women, of whom 18,992 contributed to endpoint-specific analyses. Explicit CIN2+/CIN3+/HSIL+ event rates were 1.9–6.8% in most studies, with 11.8% in one earlier intensively verified cohort; higher rates in other reports reflected any-grade CIN or composite outcomes and were not treated as CIN2+. In the subset reporting directly comparable accuracy measures, hrHPV testing was generally more sensitive than cytology and negative predictive values were 98.0–100%. These values require caution because recurrence prevalence was low and histological verification was incomplete in several cohorts. Five studies were judged at low, eight at unclear, and two at high overall risk of bias for their diagnostic-accuracy contributions. Conclusions: The evidence supports hrHPV-based risk stratification and reduced-intensity surveillance after a negative test, but not unqualified return to routine population screening. Standardised prospective studies with uniform CIN2+ endpoints and complete verification remain needed.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:切除性高危型HPV(治疗)对宫颈上皮内瘤变2或3级(CIN2–3)有效,但残留或复发的高级别疾病在临床上仍具有重要意义。本项聚焦系统综述评估了术后高危型HPV(hrHPV)检测作为治愈试验的效用,并将其与细胞学检查和切除边缘状态进行了比较。方法:通过PubMed/MEDLINE进行文献检索,并通过结构化引文核查和针对性验证进行补充;在同行评审期间进行了补充的Embase和CENTRAL检索;本综述未进行前瞻性注册。仅当可提取高级别亚组或用于支持性定性证据时,才保留混合级别高危型HPV(队列研究)的研究。结果:十五项主要研究纳入了21,932名接受治疗的女性,其中18,992名女性参与了终点特异性分析。大多数研究中明确的CIN2+/CIN3+/HSIL+事件发生率为1.9–6.8%,其中一项较早的经过密集验证的高危型HPV(队列研究)研究为11.8%;其他报告中较高的发生率反映了任何级别的CIN或复合结局,并未被视作CIN2+。在报告直接可比准确度指标的子集中,hrHPV检测通常比细胞学检查更具敏感性,其阴性预测值为98.0–100%。这些数值需要谨慎对待,因为复发性高危型HPV(患病率)在某些研究中发生率较低,且组织学验证不完整。五项研究被判定为总体偏倚风险较低,八项为不清楚,两项为较高。结论:现有证据支持基于hrHPV的风险分层以及在检测结果为阴性后进行低强度治疗,但不支持无条件恢复常规人群筛查。需要进行标准化的前瞻性研究,以统一CIN2+终点并实现完整的验证。

papers.title: Prevalence and risk factors of human papillomavirus infection and cervical cytological lesions among women in Shanxi, China: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background With the introduction of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination into China’s national immunization programme in November 2025, robust baseline evidence on HPV epidemiology is critical. Data on HPV prevalence, genotype-specific distribution, risk factors, and the association between HPV infection and cervical cytology will provide a reference for monitoring vaccine impact and optimizing future cervical cancer prevention strategies. Methods We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional study of women undergoing routine health examinations with concurrent HPV DNA testing and cervical cytology between January 2021 to December 2024 in Shanxi, China. We estimated genotype-specific and grouped HPV prevalence, assessed single and multiple infections, and compared genotype distributions across cytological categories. Logistic regression was used to assess factors associated with high-risk (HR-) HPV infection and cytological abnormalities. Results Among 19,384 women (median age 42 years, interquartile range 36–51), HR-HPV prevalence was 10.9%. The most frequent HR-HPV genotypes were HPV52 (2.3%), HPV16 (1.7%), and HPV58 (1.7%). The prevalence of HPV16/18 and HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58 was 2.3% and 7.4%, respectively. HR-HPV prevalence was higher in women aged ≥ 56 years (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 2.0, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.6–2.3 for women aged 56–65 years compared to those aged 20–35 years) and lower in married women (AOR = 0.5, 95% CI 0.4–0.7). Abnormal cytology was observed in 2.1% of participants. Among HPV-positive women, HPV16/18 prevalence increased from low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (LSIL) to atypical squamous cells cannot exclude HSIL (ASC-H)/high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) (OR = 3.4, 95% CI 1.0–11.5), while HPV31/33/45/52/58 prevalence showed a moderate but non-significant increase (1.8, 95% CI 0.6–5.6). Non-16/18/31/33/45/52/58 HR-HPV genotypes decreased with severity (OR = 0.6, 95% CI 0.1–2.2). Conclusions HR-HPV infection was common among women undergoing health examinations in Shanxi with HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 being the predominant genotypes, and HR-HPV prevalence increased with age. HPV genotype distributions varied substantially across different grades of cytological abnormalities, with HPV16/18 accounting for a larger proportion of high-grade cervical abnormalities. These findings highlight the importance of genotype-specific risk assessment in supporting genotype-specific risk assessment in HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention strategies.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background With the introduction of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination into China’s national immunization programme in November 2025, robust baseline evidence on HPV epidemiology is critical. Data on HPV prevalence, genotype-specific distribution, risk factors, and the association between HPV infection and cervical cytology will provide a reference for monitoring vaccine impact and optimizing future cervical cancer prevention strategies. Methods We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional study of women undergoing routine health examinations with concurrent HPV DNA testing and cervical cytology between January 2021 to December 2024 in Shanxi, China. We estimated genotype-specific and grouped HPV prevalence, assessed single and multiple infections, and compared genotype distributions across cytological categories. Logistic regression was used to assess factors associated with high-risk (HR-) HPV infection and cytological abnormalities. Results Among 19,384 women (median age 42 years, interquartile range 36–51), HR-HPV prevalence was 10.9%. The most frequent HR-HPV genotypes were HPV52 (2.3%), HPV16 (1.7%), and HPV58 (1.7%). The prevalence of HPV16/18 and HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58 was 2.3% and 7.4%, respectively. HR-HPV prevalence was higher in women aged ≥ 56 years (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 2.0, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.6–2.3 for women aged 56–65 years compared to those aged 20–35 years) and lower in married women (AOR = 0.5, 95% CI 0.4–0.7). Abnormal cytology was observed in 2.1% of participants. Among HPV-positive women, HPV16/18 prevalence increased from low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (LSIL) to atypical squamous cells cannot exclude HSIL (ASC-H)/high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) (OR = 3.4, 95% CI 1.0–11.5), while HPV31/33/45/52/58 prevalence showed a moderate but non-significant increase (1.8, 95% CI 0.6–5.6). Non-16/18/31/33/45/52/58 HR-HPV genotypes decreased with severity (OR = 0.6, 95% CI 0.1–2.2). Conclusions HR-HPV infection was common among women undergoing health examinations in Shanxi with HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 being the predominant genotypes, and HR-HPV prevalence increased with age. HPV genotype distributions varied substantially across different grades of cytological abnormalities, with HPV16/18 accounting for a larger proportion of high-grade cervical abnormalities. These findings highlight the importance of genotype-specific risk assessment in supporting genotype-specific risk assessment in HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention strategies.

papers.title: Diagnostic utility and tissue localization of HPV16 and HPV18 E7 immunohistochemistry in cervical lesion progression: a comparative study with PCR
papers.abstract: Background Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16 and HPV18, contributes to cervical carcinogenesis through sustained expression of the viral E7 oncoprotein. Although HPV DNA polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is widely used for viral detection, it does not directly reflect biologically active oncogenic transformation within tissue. This study evaluated the diagnostic utility, clinicopathological significance, tissue localization, and concordance of HPV16 and HPV18 E7 immunohistochemistry (IHC) across the spectrum of cervical lesion progression. Methods A retrospective study was conducted on 109 formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded cervical tissue specimens representing non-neoplastic, premalignant, and malignant lesions. HPV16 and HPV18 E7 protein expression was assessed by immunohistochemistry and compared with HPV DNA PCR findings. Concordance analysis, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, and multivariable logistic regression were performed to evaluate diagnostic performance and independent predictive value. Results HPV16 and HPV18 E7 expression increased progressively with lesion severity, with the highest immunoreactivity observed in high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions and invasive carcinoma. Substantial concordance was observed between IHC and PCR findings for both HPV types. HPV16 demonstrated superior diagnostic performance, with sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and area under the curve (AUC) values of 92.3%, 83.9%, 89.9%, and 0.925, respectively, compared with HPV18 (90.0%, 79.3%, 83.7%, and 0.894). Multivariable logistic regression identified HPV16 and HPV18 E7 expression as significant independent predictors of disease status. Histopathological evaluation demonstrated progressive localization patterns, transitioning from focal basal/parabasal staining in low-grade lesions to diffuse full-thickness epithelial and tumor-associated expression in high-grade lesions and invasive carcinoma. Conclusions HPV16 and HPV18 E7 immunohistochemistry demonstrated strong association with cervical lesion severity and substantial concordance with PCR findings, supporting its potential utility as a complementary tissue-based biomarker in cervical pathology. The findings further suggest that E7 immunohistochemistry may provide clinically relevant information regarding biologically active HPV-driven transformation and improve lesion characterization in diagnostically challenging cases.

source_records.title: Diagnostic utility and tissue localization of HPV16 and HPV18 E7 immunohistochemistry in cervical lesion progression: a comparative study with PCR
source_records.abstract: Background Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16 and HPV18, contributes to cervical carcinogenesis through sustained expression of the viral E7 oncoprotein. Although HPV DNA polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is widely used for viral detection, it does not directly reflect biologically active oncogenic transformation within tissue. This study evaluated the diagnostic utility, clinicopathological significance, tissue localization, and concordance of HPV16 and HPV18 E7 immunohistochemistry (IHC) across the spectrum of cervical lesion progression. Methods A retrospective study was conducted on 109 formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded cervical tissue specimens representing non-neoplastic, premalignant, and malignant lesions. HPV16 and HPV18 E7 protein expression was assessed by immunohistochemistry and compared with HPV DNA PCR findings. Concordance analysis, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, and multivariable logistic regression were performed to evaluate diagnostic performance and independent predictive value. Results HPV16 and HPV18 E7 expression increased progressively with lesion severity, with the highest immunoreactivity observed in high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions and invasive carcinoma. Substantial concordance was observed between IHC and PCR findings for both HPV types. HPV16 demonstrated superior diagnostic performance, with sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and area under the curve (AUC) values of 92.3%, 83.9%, 89.9%, and 0.925, respectively, compared with HPV18 (90.0%, 79.3%, 83.7%, and 0.894). Multivariable logistic regression identified HPV16 and HPV18 E7 expression as significant independent predictors of disease status. Histopathological evaluation demonstrated progressive localization patterns, transitioning from focal basal/parabasal staining in low-grade lesions to diffuse full-thickness epithelial and tumor-associated expression in high-grade lesions and invasive carcinoma. Conclusions HPV16 and HPV18 E7 immunohistochemistry demonstrated strong association with cervical lesion severity and substantial concordance with PCR findings, supporting its potential utility as a complementary tissue-based biomarker in cervical pathology. The findings further suggest that E7 immunohistochemistry may provide clinically relevant information regarding biologically active HPV-driven transformation and improve lesion characterization in diagnostically challenging cases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 免疫组织化学在宫颈病变进展中的诊断效用和组织定位,解决 PCR 在反映组织内生物活性致癌转化方面的局限性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 109 份代表非肿瘤、癌前和恶性病变的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋宫颈组织标本进行了回顾性研究。
elements_zh.methods: 通过免疫组织化学评估 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 蛋白表达,并与 HPV DNA PCR 结果进行比较。进行一致性分析、受试者工作特征(ROC)分析和多变量逻辑回归来评估诊断性能和独立预测价值。
elements_zh.main_results: HPV16和HPV18的E7表达随着病变程度的加重而逐渐增加,在高级别鳞状上皮内病变和浸润性癌中观察到最高的免疫反应性。HPV16在敏感性、特异性、准确性和曲线下面积(AUC)方面均表现出优于HPV18的诊断性能,分别为92.3%、83.9%、89.9%和0.925,而HPV18分别为90.0%、79.3%、83.7%和0.894。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,HPV16和HPV18的E7免疫组化与宫颈病变程度有很强的关联性,并且与PCR结果有显著的一致性,支持其作为宫颈病理学中互补的组织生物标志物的潜在应用价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果进一步表明,E7免疫组化可能提供与生物活性HPV驱动转化相关的临床相关信息,并有助于在诊断困难的病例中改善病变特征的判断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到回顾性设计和小样本量的限制,这可能会影响其结果的普遍适用性。然而,免疫组化与PCR结果之间高度的一致性以及HPV16优越的诊断性能支持了这些结果的可靠性。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV),特别是 HPV16 和 HPV18 的持续感染,通过病毒 E7 癌蛋白的持续表达导致宫颈癌发生。尽管 HPV DNA 聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 广泛用于病毒检测,但它并不能直接反映组织内具有生物活性的致癌转化。本研究评估了 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 免疫组织化学 (IHC) 在宫颈病变进展过程中的诊断效用、临床病理学意义、组织定位和一致性。方法对109例代表非肿瘤、癌前和恶性病变的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋宫颈组织标本进行回顾性研究。通过免疫组织化学评估 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 蛋白表达,并与 HPV DNA PCR 结果进行比较。进行一致性分析、受试者工作特征(ROC)分析和多变量逻辑回归来评估诊断性能和独立预测价值。结果 HPV16和HPV18 E7表达随病变严重程度逐渐增加,在高级别鳞状上皮内病变和浸润性癌中观察到免疫反应性最高。两种 HPV 类型的 IHC 和 PCR 结果之间观察到显着的一致性。与 HPV18(90.0%、79.3%、83.7% 和 0.894)相比,HPV16 表现出卓越的诊断性能,敏感性、特异性、准确性和曲线下面积 (AUC) 值分别为 92.3%、83.9%、89.9% 和 0.925。多变量逻辑回归将 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 表达确定为疾病状态的重要独立预测因子。组织病理学评估显示渐进的定位模式,从低级别病变中的局灶性基底/副基底染色转变为高级别病变和浸润性癌中的弥漫性全层上皮和肿瘤相关表达。结论 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 免疫组织化学显示与宫颈病变严重程度密切相关,并且与 PCR 结果基本一致,支持其作为宫颈病理学中基于组织的补充生物标志物的潜在用途。研究结果进一步表明,E7 免疫组织化学可以提供有关生物活性 HPV 驱动的转化的临床相关信息,并改善诊断困难病例中的病变特征。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 免疫组织化学在宫颈病变进展中的诊断效用和组织定位,解决 PCR 在反映组织内生物活性致癌转化方面的局限性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 109 份代表非肿瘤、癌前和恶性病变的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋宫颈组织标本进行了回顾性研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过免疫组织化学评估 HPV16 和 HPV18 E7 蛋白表达,并与 HPV DNA PCR 结果进行比较。进行一致性分析、受试者工作特征(ROC)分析和多变量逻辑回归来评估诊断性能和独立预测价值。
analysis_zh.main_results: HPV16和HPV18的E7表达随着病变程度的加重而逐渐增加,在高级别鳞状上皮内病变和浸润性癌中观察到最高的免疫反应性。HPV16在敏感性、特异性、准确性和曲线下面积(AUC)方面均表现出优于HPV18的诊断性能,分别为92.3%、83.9%、89.9%和0.925,而HPV18分别为90.0%、79.3%、83.7%和0.894。

papers.title: Multiple High-Risk HPV Infections and Opportunistic HPV Prevalence Among Women Aged 18–25 Years with NILM, ASC-US, or LSIL Cytology: A 2024 Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Multiple high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infections in young women are poorly characterized across age and cytology, particularly with partial genotyping. We assessed multiple hrHPV infections among HPV-positive women aged 18–25 years with NILM, ASC-US, or LSIL; the secondary objective was hrHPV positivity among electively tested women with NILM. This retrospective cross-sectional study analyzed 2024 laboratory data from northern Slovakia. Of 7613 unique women, 7574 met cytological eligibility criteria; 804 underwent cobas 4800 testing, and 295 were hrHPV-positive. Multiple infection, defined as concurrent detection of at least two reportable categories (HPV16, HPV18, or other hrHPV), occurred in 69/295 women (23.4%; 95% CI, 18.9–28.5%). No statistically detectable variation was observed by cytology after age adjustment (p = 0.471) or by age after cytology adjustment (p = 0.891). Among women with multiple infections, HPV16 combined with other hrHPV was the most frequent pattern (30/69; 43.5%). Among 396 electively tested women with NILM, 75 were hrHPV-positive (18.9%; 95% CI, 15.4–23.1%); positivity was lower at ages 23–25 than 18–22 (10.6% vs. 26.6%; OR, 0.33; 95% CI, 0.19–0.57; p < 0.001). The NILM estimate describes a self-selected preventive cohort and is not population-representative.

analysis.summary_en: This 2024 cross-sectional study in northern Slovakia examined multiple high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infections among women aged 18–25 with NILM, ASC-US, or LSIL cytology. The study found that 23.4% of hrHPV-positive women had multiple infections, with HPV16 combined with other hrHPV being the most frequent pattern. No significant variation in multiple infection rates was observed by cytology or age after adjustments. The study highlights the need for further research into hrHPV dynamics in young women, as the NILM cohort may not be representative of the general population. The evidence is moderate due to the retrospective design and potential selection bias.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在年轻女性中,多重高危型HPV(hrHPV)感染在年龄和细胞学检查方面特征不明确,尤其是在部分基因分型的情况下。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性横断面研究分析了2024年来自斯洛伐克北部的实验室数据。在7613名唯一女性中,7574名符合细胞学检查标准;804名接受了cobas 4800检测,其中295名为hrHPV阳性。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用 2024 年的实验室数据并应用 cobas 4800 检测来识别 hrHPV 阳性。多重感染定义为同时检测到至少两种可报告类别(HPV16、HPV18 或其他 hrHPV)。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在年龄调整后,细胞学检查未观察到统计学上显著的差异(p = 0.471);在细胞学调整后,年龄也未观察到统计学上显著的差异(p = 0.891)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,年轻女性中多重hrHPV感染较为常见,但其并不显著随细胞学检查或年龄变化,这可能为未来的监测和预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: NILM的估计值描述了一种自我选择的预防性检测,并不代表整个人群。由于研究设计为回顾性,且可能存在选择偏倚,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Recurrence and Circulating Tumor DNA in Human Papillomavirus‐Positive Oropharyngeal Cancer: A Meta‐Analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To perform a systematic review and meta‐analysis on the utility of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in serum as a biomarker for post‐treatment surveillance of human papillomavirus (HPV)‐positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC), given the improved treatment response and 10% to 20% recurrence rate in this patient population. Data Sources Articles were sourced from PubMed. Studies were excluded if they focused on HPV‐driven cancers in other anatomical regions, lacked pretreatment and posttreatment HPV viral load data, or were published more than 20 years ago. All literature available in English was considered. Review Methods A PRISMA‐compliant review identified 419 articles, and 20 studies met all inclusion criteria. Data extraction and quality assessment were performed using Oxford Centre for Evidence‐Based Medicine and Newcastle‐Ottawa Scale criteria. Results Across 3505 clinically correlated tests, pooled sensitivity was 80.3% (95% CI 70.9%‐87.2%) and specificity was 95.5% (90.9%‐97.8%). Meta‐analysis of our studies found the overall prevalence of recurrent HPV + OPSCC after curative treatment was 9.70% (95% CI 8.72%‐10.78%). Negative Predictive Value (NPV) at this prevalence was 97.7% (96.7%‐98.5%) and Positive Predictive Value (PPV) was 66.0% (49.5%‐80.3%). A positive test for ctDNA after curative treatment had a 130.3 (95% CI 56.60‐298.71) fold higher odds of disease recurrence compared to a negative test. Conclusions CtDNA is a promising biomarker for early detection of recurrence. Standardized protocols and quantitative thresholds are needed to fully establish its role in clinical practice.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 本研究旨在对循环肿瘤DNA(ctDNA)在血清中作为生物标志物用于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌(OPSCC)患者在根治性治疗治疗后复发的检测价值进行系统综述和荟萃分析,鉴于该患者群体中治疗反应改善且复发率为10%至20%。数据来源 文章来源于PubMed。排除标准包括:研究对象为其他解剖部位的HPV驱动型癌症、缺乏治疗前和治疗后HPV病毒载量数据、或发表时间超过20年的研究。所有英文文献均被纳入考虑。综述方法 采用PRISMA合规的综述方法,共筛选出419篇文章,其中20项研究符合所有纳入标准。数据提取和质量评估采用牛津循证医学中心和新泽西-奥塔瓦量表标准。结果 在3505项临床相关检测中,汇总敏感度为80.3%(95% CI 70.9%-87.2%),特异度为95.5%(90.9%-97.8%)。对本研究的荟萃分析显示,根治性治疗治疗后复发的HPV阳性OPSCC总体患病率为9.70%(95% CI 8.72%-10.78%)。在该患病率下,阴性预测值(NPV)为97.7%(96.7%-98.5%),阳性预测值(PPV)为66.0%(49.5%-80.3%)。根治性治疗治疗后ctDNA检测呈阳性结果的患者,其疾病复发的比值比(OR)为130.3(95% CI 56.60-298.71),显著高于阴性结果。结论 ctDNA是早期检测复发的有前景的生物标志物。需要标准化的协议和定量阈值以充分确立其在临床实践中的作用。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在3505项临床相关检测中,汇总敏感度为80.3%(95% CI 70.9%-87.2%),特异度为95.5%(90.9%-97.8%)。根治性治疗治疗后复发的HPV阳性OPSCC总体患病率为9.70%(95% CI 8.72%-10.78%)。在该患病率下,阴性预测值(NPV)为97.7%(96.7%-98.5%),阳性预测值(PPV)为66.0%(49.5%-80.3%)。根治性治疗治疗后ctDNA检测呈阳性结果的患者,其疾病复发的比值比(OR)为130.3(95% CI 56.60-298.71),显著高于阴性结果。ctDNA是早期检测复发的有前景的生物标志物。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 需要标准化的协议和定量阈值以充分确立其在临床实践中的作用。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要标准化的协议和定量阈值以充分确立ctDNA在临床实践中的作用,用于早期检测HPV阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌的复发。

papers.title: Lactobacillus Depletion and Cervicovaginal Dysbiosis in Human Papillomavirus Persistence and Cervical Lesion Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: This systematic review and meta-analysis will investigate whether alterations in the cervicovaginal microbiome are associated with the persistence or clearance of human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and with the subsequent clinical course of cervical lesions. Particular emphasis will be placed on Lactobacillus depletion, loss of Lactobacillus dominance, Lactobacillus species composition, community state types, microbial diversity, bacterial vaginosis, and the enrichment of potentially pathogenic or anaerobic bacterial taxa. The review will primarily include longitudinal observational studies involving women or adolescent females with repeated HPV testing and/or follow-up assessment of cervical intraepithelial lesions. Eligible outcomes will include type-specific or high-risk HPV persistence and clearance, acquisition of new HPV infection, and the persistence, progression, regression, or recurrence of cervical cytological or histological abnormalities. Studies evaluating microbiome-modifying or lesion-directed interventions will be considered separately as treatment-associated cohorts and will not be combined uncritically with untreated observational populations. Where sufficient clinical and methodological homogeneity exists, quantitative synthesis will estimate associations between cervicovaginal microbial characteristics and HPV or cervical lesion outcomes. Molecular microbiome studies, targeted analyses of specific bacterial taxa, and studies using clinical indicators of vaginal microecology or bacterial vaginosis will be analysed in prespecified categories. Sources of heterogeneity will be explored according to microbiome assessment method, HPV genotype, follow-up duration, population characteristics, HIV status, vaccination status, treatment exposure, and cervical disease severity. The anticipated outcome is a rigorous synthesis of the longitudinal evidence concerning the prognostic significance of cervicovaginal dysbiosis in HPV-related disease. The findings may help identify microbial biomarkers for risk stratification, clarify priorities for future prospective research, and inform the development of microbiome-based monitoring or therapeutic strategies.

The review focuses on longitudinal observational studies involving women or adolescent females with repeated HPV testing and follow-up assessments of cervical intraepithelial lesions. It will explore sources of heterogeneity, including microbiome assessment methods, HPV genotypes, follow-up duration, and population characteristics. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 这项系统回顾和荟萃分析将调查宫颈阴道微生物组的改变是否与 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染的持续或清除以及随后的宫颈病变临床病程相关。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 综述将主要纳入涉及女性或青少年女性的纵向观察性研究,这些研究包含重复的人乳头瘤病毒检测或宫颈上皮内瘤变的随访评估。在临床和方法学上存在足够同质性的情况下,定量综合分析将估计宫颈阴道微生物特征与人乳头瘤病毒或宫颈病变结局之间的关联。合格的结局包括特定型别或高危型HPV的持续或清除、新的人乳头瘤病毒感染获得,以及宫颈细胞学或组织学异常的持续、进展、消退或复发。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 预期结果是对与人乳头瘤病毒相关疾病中宫颈阴道菌群失调的预后意义的纵向证据进行严谨的综合分析。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 异质性的来源将根据微生物群评估方法、人乳头瘤病毒基因型、随访时间、人群特征、HIV状态、疫苗接种状态、治疗暴露和宫颈疾病严重程度进行探讨。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 评估微生物组改变或针对病变的干预措施的研究将单独考虑为 治疗 相关 队列研究,并且不会不加批判地与未经治疗的观察人群合并。这些发现可能有助于识别用于风险分层的微生物生物标志物,明确未来前瞻性研究的优先事项,并为基于微生物组的监测或治疗策略的发展提供信息。

The anticipated outcome is a rigorous synthesis of the longitudinal evidence concerning the prognostic significance of cervicovaginal dysbiosis in HPV-related disease. The findings may help identify microbial biomarkers for risk stratification, clarify priorities for future prospective research, and inform the development of microbiome-based monitoring or therapeutic strategies.

However, persistent infection, particularly in women over 35 years of age, may increase the risk of progression and lead to prolonged surveillance, repeated examinations and patient anxiety. This study evaluates the effectiveness of local treatment with carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil (Colpofix®) in achieving negativization of high-risk (HR) human papillomavirus (HPV) in a Spanish population of women with HR-HPV positivity. Methods: This prospective, non-randomized controlled, multi-centre study enrolled 533 women aged 25–65 with HR-HPV and normal cytology, atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance or low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the effectiveness of local treatment with carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil (Colpofix®) in achieving HR-HPV negativization in women with HR-HPV positivity and normal or low-grade cervical cytology. The prospective, non-randomized, multi-centre study enrolled 533 women aged 25–65 and compared a 3-month treatment regimen with a ‘wait-and-see’ approach, with follow-up at 6 months. The main results showed that 50.1% of treated patients achieved HR-HPV negativity at 6 months, compared to 24.0% in the observation group. The study was conducted in real clinical settings, which enhances its practical relevance. However, the evidence does not provide a detailed assessment of limitations or the strength of the findings.

papers.title: Associations of temperature, particulate matter, and greenness with human papillomavirus positivity at screening: an analysis of Guangdong Province (2016–2022) using the treed distributed lag nonlinear model
papers.abstract: Introduction Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a double-stranded DNA virus that may cause cervical, vulvar, and anal cancers in women. Environmental factors including temperature, air pollution, and greenness may be associated with HPV positivity; however, evidence remains limited. Methods This study analysed health examination data of 1,287,412 women in Guangdong Province, China (2016-2022). Ten covariates were collected, and temperature, particulate matter 2.5 (PM2.5), and normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) were assigned by examination date. Tree distributed lag non-linear models were applied to evaluate lagged associations with HPV positivity at screening. Results Using the Q50 of biweekly mean temperature, PM2.5, and NDVI (25.594°C, 20.300 μg/m3, and 0.544, respectively) as references, low temperature (Q2.5, 13.300°C) was associated with higher cumulative odds of HPV positivity at Lag Weeks 3-8 (cOR = 1.303, 95% CrI, 1.194, 1.428), whereas high temperature (Q97.5, 29.851°C) showed a longer-lag association at Lag Weeks 9-14 (cOR = 1.063, 95% CrI, 1.007, 1.122). High PM2.5 (Q97.5, 38.021μg/m3) and low NDVI (Q2.5, 0.229) were associated with higher odds of HPV positivity over Lag Weeks 1-16 (cOR = 1.172, 95% CrI, 1.051, 1.283) and Lag Weeks 5-18 (cOR = 1.318, 95% CrI, 1.131, 1.566), respectively. Stratified analyses suggested stronger low-temperature associations among middle-aged and older women and among women in the Pearl River Delta and Western Guangdong. Discussion In conclusion, temperature showed lag-dependent associations with screening-detected HPV positivity, with stronger associations for low temperature at shorter lags and high temperature at longer lags. High PM2.5 and low NDVI were also associated with higher odds in the primary 24-week analyses. Temporal sensitivity analyses attenuated the PM2.5 association and weakened the NDVI association under the 36-week specification, whereas the low-temperature association was comparatively stable and uncertainty increased for high temperature. These findings identify pre-screening environmental correlates of HPV positivity and warrant confirmation in longitudinal studies with repeated HPV testing and more comprehensive control of temporal, spatial, behavioral, and socioeconomic factors.
